scope: Beautification only: no spawn, military base, resource/economy or mission-script recipes.
limits: These are MCP observations and editor diagnostics, not in-game render certification.
Unknown materials are reported but excluded from palette recipes; sampled grids use step=2.
Regional base-material counts include underwater and covered foundation cells; only dry palette statistics filter water.
Nearby decorations and local offsets show co-occurrence, not collision-free templates or guaranteed frontage.
Road candidates include sidewalks, trims and line markings; choose their actual role after visual inspection.
70 scene groups are exact scenery signatures after filtering known military/waypoints, not 70 distinct art styles.
Mod variants and unavailable objects require a matching game/MOD catalog before use.
